rationale.text: A page with an XHTML 1.0 doctype, served as text/html, whose html element carries both lang and xml:lang. For XHTML 1.0 the methodology asks for the lang and xml:lang attributes on the html tag, and the glossary makes both mandatory for XHTML 1.0 served as text/html. The first condition holds. The custom check answers no_fault through the html element (step 1), so the finding is needs_review, not_enabled, at fail_only, and would be passed at full.

citations.quote: Soit au moyen des attributs lang et xml:lang sur la balise html si le code est du XHTML 1.0 ;
Pour XHTML 1.0 servi en "text/html" : attribut lang et xml:lang obligatoires ;
L’indication de la langue de la page (attribut `lang` et/ou `xml:lang`) est donnée pour l’élément `html`
